topics.title: Introduction: identifying the problem and the target group
topics.ncert_sections: 1; Steps towards making a project (identifying a problem, choice of target group)

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why a project must begin with a clearly identified problem or area of study.
Choose a suitable target group for a project and explain its role in framing questions.

topics.title: Collection of data for a project
topics.ncert_sections: Steps towards making a project (collection of data)

concepts.learning_objective: Decide, from the objective of the survey, whether primary data, secondary data or both are needed.
State the requirements of a postal questionnaire and of a suitable sampling method.

topics.title: Organisation, analysis, conclusion and bibliography
topics.ncert_sections: Steps towards making a project (organisation and presentation, analysis and interpretation, conclusion, bibliography)

concepts.learning_objective: Identify tabulation and diagrams as the tools for organising and presenting collected data.
Select the measure of central tendency, dispersion or correlation suited to a given analytical need.
Describe the role of the conclusion and the bibliography in a project report.
Recognise that a project may take up any topic dealing with an economic issue.
Identify the data needed for a suggested project such as a savings survey or a loan proposal.

topics.title: Sample project: information needs and the questionnaire

concepts.learning_objective: List the information the toothpaste project needs and relate it to the study's objective.
Explain how the questionnaire is designed to generate the required information.

topics.title: Sample project: data analysis, interpretation and concluding note
topics.ncert_sections: 3 (data analysis and interpretation, simplified project report)

concepts.learning_objective: Calculate the mean and standard deviation of a grouped distribution by the step-deviation method.
Interpret the tables of the sample report to draw observations.
Summarise the main findings stated in the concluding note of the sample report.
